next_occurrence.description: Never has no occurrence.
01hour at :15 from 10:07 is 10:15.
A reference on an occurrence returns the next one, never itself.
One second before the occurrence returns it.
02hours anchored at 03:00 runs on odd hours: from 04:10 the next is 05:00.
03hours anchored at 05:30: hour 2 is in phase (2-5 = -3), from 00:00 the next is 02:30.
03hours anchored at 05:30: hour 0 is out of phase (0-5 = -5, remainder -2), from 23:40 the next is 02:30.
04hours anchored at 01:45 from 06:00 is 09:45.
06hours anchored at 23:00 from 06:00 is 11:00.
08hours anchored at 07:15 from 16:00 is 23:15.
12hours anchored at 13:00 also runs at 01:00.
EveryDay at 18:30 from 09:00 is today.
EveryDay at 02:00 from 09:00 is tomorrow.
Weekly Wednesday 02:00 from Wednesday 03:00 is a week later (weekday is ISO, 3 = Wednesday).
Weekly Sunday (7) 00:00 from a Wednesday.
Weekly Thursday 12:00 lands on the leap day 2024-02-29.
New York 2024-03-10: 02:30 does not exist, EveryDay 02:30 skips to 2024-03-11 02:30.
New York 2024-03-10: 01hour at :30 from 01:40 EST goes to 03:30 EDT, 02:30 does not exist.
New York 2024-03-10: 02hours anchored at 00:00 from 01:00 EST: 02:00 does not exist, the next even local hour is 04:00 EDT.
New York 2024-11-03: EveryDay 01:30 from 00:00 is 01:30 EDT, the first of the two.
New York 2024-11-03: from 01:30 EDT the next EveryDay 01:30 is 01:30 EST, one hour later (the repeated slot stays observable).
New York 2024-11-03: from 01:30 EST the next EveryDay 01:30 is the next day.
New York 2024-11-03: 01hour at :00 from 01:10 EDT is 01:00 EST.
Berlin 2024-03-31 (Sunday): Weekly Sunday 02:15 does not exist that day, the next is 2024-04-07 02:15.
Berlin 2024-10-27 (Sunday): Weekly Sunday 02:45 from 02:50 CEST is 02:45 CET the same night.
Lord Howe 2024-04-07: clocks go 02:00 back to 01:30; from 01:50 (+11) EveryDay 01:45 is 01:45 (+10:30), 25 minutes later.
Lord Howe 2024-10-06: clocks go 02:00 forward to 02:30; EveryDay 02:15 skips to the next day.
Apia skipped Friday 2011-12-30; Weekly Friday 10:00 from Thursday 2011-12-29 lands on 2012-01-06.
Monrovia 1970 is UTC-0:44:30: the quarter alignment uses local seconds; 01hour at :15.
Monrovia 1972-01-07 moves from -0:44:30 to UTC: the aligned candidate lands off the quarter after the change, so the bounded second-by-second scan finds :45.
Kathmandu is +05:45: EveryDay 00:00 local.
An unknown cadence is rejected.
Weekday 0 is rejected.
Hour 24 is rejected.
Minute 10 is rejected (quarter hours only).

plan.description: No completed occurrence: the latest occurrence in the last 15 days is due.
Completed today's occurrence: not due; next_due is tomorrow.
Completed three days ago: due once, at the latest missed occurrence.
A cursor older than 15 days is clamped to the window; the latest occurrence is due.
Weekly on Friday, now is Wednesday, completed last Friday: not due.
A disabled group is neither due nor a wake: next_due stays null.
Never: not due and no wake.
An override replaces the default schedule; the earliest next among groups is next_due.
Due ids keep the model's order.
A completion cursor after now (clock went back): nothing in (cursor, now], not due.
now exactly on the occurrence: it is due (occurrence <= now).
New York 2024-11-03 01:40 EST: completed 01:30 EDT, the repeated 01:30 EST is due.
New York 2024-03-10 04:00 EDT: EveryDay 02:30 completed on the 9th; the 10th has no 02:30, not due.
No groups: nothing due, no wake.

extra_plan.description: Without a cache the planner's due set is used: both Extras never ran, both due (dcc first).
Without a cache, Extras completed today are not due.
With a cache, a planner-due Extra also needs its cache next_due <= now.
With a cache lacking the Extra's entry, it is not due.
An unattempted pending occurrence is due when the cache says so, even if the planner does not.
An attempted pending occurrence is not re-run from the pending marker alone.
A failed (attempted) dcc whose pending occurrence is the planner's latest one is due again once the cache says so.
A disabled bl is never due.
GeoIP generation mid-swap forces dcc due even when completed; it is appended after bl.
GeoIP mid-swap does not force a disabled dcc.
Weekly bl on Friday completed last Friday is not due on Wednesday; dcc is.

next_due.description: A due feed makes cron next_due = now; last_run is the newest success.
Nothing due: cron next_due is the earliest next occurrence.
A pending occurrence on an enabled feed keeps cron due now.
An attempted pending occurrence counts as completed for planning; last_run falls back to the completed occurrence.
Scheduled updates off: no cron entry; Extras still get theirs.
dcc never ran (due now); bl has an unattempted pending occurrence (due now).
An attempted Extra pending in the future is referenced from that occurrence.
A failed (attempted) dcc counts its pending occurrence as completed: next_due is the next day's occurrence, not now.
A disabled feed's state (a newer check, a pending occurrence) touches neither cron's last_run nor its next_due.
New York 2024-11-03 00:50 EDT, EveryDay 01:30 completed the day before: not due, cron next_due is 01:30 EDT.
Scheduled on but every feed disabled: no wake, so no cron entry.

quiet_hours.description: No window: apply now.
02:00-06:00 at 02:00: the start is inside.
02:00-06:00 at 06:00: the end is outside.
Equal start and end: no deferral.
Single-digit hours are a valid window: 2:00-6:00 at 12:00 is outside (a malformed one would apply now).
A malformed window fails safe to apply-now.
Hour 24 fails safe to apply-now.
Minute 60 fails safe to apply-now.
A three-digit hour does not match the format: apply-now.
A trailing newline still matches ($ without D): 02:00-06:00\n at 12:00 is outside.
The window is local time: 06:15 UTC is 12:00 in Kathmandu, inside 11:45-12:15.
The same instant in UTC (06:15) is outside 11:45-12:15.
New York 2024-03-10 03:30 EDT (07:30 UTC) is inside 03:00-04:00 local.
New York 2024-03-10 01:59 EST is outside 02:00-03:00 (that hour does not exist).
New York 2024-11-03 01:30 EST (the repeat) is inside 01:00-02:00 local.
Lord Howe 2024-04-07 01:45 (+10:30, after the clocks went back) is inside 01:30-02:00.

A numeric item key is invalid.
A key PHP reads as numeric with leading whitespace (" 7") is invalid.
A key with trailing whitespace ("7 ") is numeric in PHP 8, invalid.
An empty item key is invalid.
An item with no fields is invalid.
An item must be an object.
An unknown item field is invalid.
A timestamp past int64 decodes as float: invalid.
A pending occurrence must be after the completed one.
Text that is not JSON is unreadable.

set_pending.description: A new item gets the pending occurrence.
An existing pending occurrence is kept (first reservation wins).
An occurrence not after the completed one is not reserved.
An occurrence after the completed one is reserved.
Several ids at once; other items are untouched.
A negative occurrence is rejected and nothing is written.

record_outcome.description: Success records the check time and completes the pending occurrence.
Success with nothing pending records only the check time.
retry-cap-reached completes the pending occurrence without a success time.
retry-cap-reached with nothing pending changes nothing.
An expected occurrence that matches the pending one completes it.
An expected occurrence that differs (a newer reservation) changes nothing.
An expected occurrence with nothing pending changes nothing.
An id outside the feed/Extra grammar is rejected.
Only dcc and bl are Extras.
A new completion replaces the previous one and its outcome.
